name: matching-exercises
title: Matching / Sort / Categorize Exercises
description: The RF-3 interaction family: MatchingExercise, SortExercise, and CategorizeExercise. Matching uses identical fixed nodes on both sides, with connection points on opposite edges; its primary interaction lets the learner click anywhere on each node, while the SVG line still runs exactly between the two filled points and drag remains optional. Categorize physically moves and reflows cards across an Unassigned lane and category columns; Sort reorders a list. Every variant includes a non-dragging WCAG 2.5.7 path, pointer and keyboard support, controlled/uncontrolled values, text-and-icon results, feedback, empty states, and token-only styling.
